recall.minute: Time complexity measures how running time grows with input size; Big O gives the order of growth, in ML in terms of samples n and features d. log₂ n counts halvings, so 1,000 items need about 10 binary-search steps and a billion about 30. Classes: O(1) array access, O(log n) binary search, O(n) linear scan, O(n log n) mergesort and heapsort, O(n²) simple sorts and pairwise similarity, O(n!) brute-force travelling salesman. Lists are dynamic arrays of references, tuples immutable records, dictionaries hash tables with O(1) average operations and hashable unique keys, NumPy arrays homogeneous contiguous vectorised storage (np.sum about 100× faster than sum on a list), and DataFrames labelled tables for cleaning and grouping. Choose lists for collections, dicts for lookups, tuples for shapes, NumPy for X, y and weights, and DataFrames for CSV data. In OOP, inheritance comes in single, multilevel, hierarchical, multiple and hybrid forms and polymorphism in compile-time and run-time forms; in agentic AI classes define agents, objects run them, polymorphic execute() varies by role, and composition builds workflows, while helpers such as read_paper stay functional.
